segments.text: ALmightie GOD, whiche haſte knitte together thy electe in one Cōmunion and felowſhip in the miſticall body of thy ſonne Chriſte our Lorde: graunt vs grace ſo to folow thy holy Sainctes in all vertues, and godly liuyng, that we maye come to thoſe vnſpeakeable ioyes, whiche thou haſt prepared for all them that vnfaynedly loue thee: through Ieſus Chriſte.
